error_policy: Record every error and stop; no retry or recovery converts an errored monitor into a pass.
process_policy: Controller owns supervisor; supervisor owns one persistent NVML sampler; neither imports torch, DGL, CUDA Python, or native feature stores.
device_policy: Select physical GPU index using NVML, record physical GPU UUID on every sample, and reject an identity change.
memory_policy: Record summed supervisor and sampler RSS; enforce a conservative sum of their VmHWM against the existing 64 MiB budget.
acceptance: At least one sample, zero errors, bounded sampler shutdown and complete summary; external review retains worker coverage and strict smoke checks.
gpu_memory_policy: NVML v2 used bytes excludes driver/firmware reserved memory, matching nvidia-smi memory.used apart from nvidia-smi whole-MiB display truncation. Record total/free/reserved separately; no v1 fallback.
